outputs.explanation: Panel a is a schematic icon plus micrographs illustrating cropping/rotation/resizing; it contains no plot of averaged data.
Panel b is a schematic plus micrographs illustrating image spacing; no plot present.
Panel c is a schematic plus micrographs illustrating insets/zoom; no plot present.
Panel d shows a brightness/contrast slider schematic and grayscale micrographs; no plot of averaged data.
Panel e shows schematic color/contrast icons and micrographs illustrating channel annotation; no plot present.
Panel f shows a schematic overlap diagram and grayscale/color micrographs; no plot of averaged data.
Panel g shows micrographs with calibration/intensity scale bars, which are not bar/line/scatter plots of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
